title: Occupancy step: DCV opens the dampers, CO2 settles below 800 ppm

checks.name: DCV opens the dampers after the occupancy step
CO2 peak after opening stays below 850 ppm
DCV closes the dampers again once CO2 has fallen
CO2 below 800 ppm at the end
SAT within 13 +-1 C before the step (240-370 s)
SAT back within 13 +-1 C within 150 s of the damper step
checks.detail: peak deviation 3.1 K, recovered after 133 s
